entities.summary: Roland Dubillard (b. 1923-12-02, 7th arrondissement of Paris) was a journalist or media commentator of the Modern era, defined by industrialization, revolution, and global conflict, active in 7th arrondissement of Paris and France. Known in the fields of france, poets & playwrights, europe.
